sources.name: MTGGoldfish Modern Metagame
sources.description: Aggregates recent tournament results and league finishes to show general archetype shares, price trends, and sample decklists.
sources.value_to_lantern: Identifies the macro-level composition of the format (e.g., whether aggro, control, or combo is dominating) to adjust the mainboard/sideboard ratio of Ensnaring Bridges and lock pieces.

sources.name: MTGO Official Standings
sources.description: Official listings of Magic Online (MTGO) Challenges, Qualifiers, and 5-0 League decklists published directly by Daybreak Games.
sources.value_to_lantern: The most hyper-competitive source of online metagame trends. Challenge results capture the cutting-edge builds and sideboard trends of the tier-1 decks.

sources.name: MTGTop8 Modern Section
sources.description: An extensive database aggregating both digital (MTGO) and global paper events, categorized cleanly with deck download options.
sources.value_to_lantern: Highly efficient for downloading specific archetype files (.dec, .txt) to feed into custom simulator or analysis scripts.

sources.name: Melee.gg
sources.description: The primary platform used to run paper Regional Championships, RCQs, and major independent circuits (such as Star City Games).
sources.value_to_lantern: Provides comprehensive swiss-round standings and exact match-up win rates, exposing decks that are highly represented but performing poorly vs. decks that are underrepresented but overperforming.

sources.name: Lantern Control Discord
sources.description: A dedicated Discord community focused on the design, tuning, and strategic play of Lantern Control.
sources.value_to_lantern: Real-time discussion on card choices, micro-optimizations, matchup guides, and sideboard configurations from experienced archetype specialists.

sources.name: Moxfield Public Search
sources.description: The largest and most modern deck-building database where players post active lists and detailed primers.
sources.value_to_lantern: Useful for detecting experimental tech, new card inclusions from upcoming sets, or community consensus on card ratios.

sources.name: Hareruya Modern Decklists
sources.description: Decklists and standings from Japan's largest MTG tournament organizer and retailer.
sources.value_to_lantern: Historically, the Japanese Modern metagame is highly innovative, often brewing unique control/prison variations. Excellent for uncovering non-standard/unconventional tech.

sources.name: Reddit ModernMagic
sources.description: A community discussion board containing tournament reports, metagame reviews, and format complaints/sentiment.
sources.value_to_lantern: Helps track format sentiment, hate-card trends (e.g., if players are registering more Force of Vigor or Haywire Mite in their sideboards), and overall meta adaptations.
